provenance: Tight-junction scaffolds and non-claudin strands (occludin, ZO, JAM, cingulin, PAR3/PATJ). Claudins are omitted so the score is not the CRISPR deletion itself. Membership follows the TJ core list used in the CLDN4/TACSTD2 KD-KO wave, minus every Cldn symbol.
Adherens-junction proteins the source paper immunoblotted (E-cadherin, alpha-catenin, beta-catenin, p120, vinculin).

Mouse orthologs of the type-I ISG module used in the KD-KO wave. Human symbols with no 1:1 mouse gene are replaced by the standard ortholog (OAS1->Oas1a, OASL->Oasl1 and Oasl2, HERC5->Herc6, TRIM22->Trim30a, IFI27->Ifi27 and Ifi27l2a) rather than by title-case.
Mouse orthologs of the type-II IFN module used in the KD-KO wave. HLA-DR/DQ genes map to H2-Aa, H2-Ab1, and H2-Eb1. GBP1 is not used; mouse Gbp2, Gbp3, and Gbp5 are.
Mouse MHC-I antigen-processing machinery. Classical and non-classical H2 genes stand in for HLA-A/B/C/E.
Checkpoint transcripts scored in the KD-KO wave, mouse symbols. Epithelial lines often do not express the receptors.
Epithelial-identity genes from the KD-KO wave with Cldn3/4/7 removed, so the score is not the knockout.
